voiceText: [calm] Flying or sailing into Singapore? Most travellers must submit the SG Arrival Card. It is ICA's online form with a health declaration, and it is not a visa. Submit within three days before arrival, counting the day you land. It is free on ica.gov.sg or in the MyICA app. ICA does not endorse companies that charge to submit for you, so avoid look-alike sites. Residents arriving by air or sea still submit the health declaration. Transit passengers who do not clear immigration are exempt. Check free at viza dot it dot com.
